title: Studio action editor: stop offering `aria` on an action once the spec pin carries the action.aria tombstone (objectstack#20323)
body:
Follow-up of objectstack-ai/objectstack#20323, filed by the `domain:spec` seat 4 of objectstack (`session_01ARcDurZ5j34RdqsGgc4jgH`, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#18917) as that card's triage note 3 asked. ⛔ Filed bare: routing, `domain:*` and grading belong to objectui's triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What changed upstream

`@objectstack/spec` retired `aria` on an action. objectstack PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#20398 merged as `dcd3bceaa068fc3cfb589bd6e04cd0b89b660580`, and ships in the release after `17.4.0`. `ActionSchema.aria` is now a `retiredKey()` tombstone:
- authoring `aria` on an action (`actions[]` or `objects[].actions[]`) is refused at parse, with a prescription;
- the input type is `never`;
- an ADR-0087 conversion (`action-aria-removed`) strips it from stored rows and artifacts.

The reason: no action surface ever applied it. At the pin `f8a9d0fb05`, the objectstack review measured 0 readers of an action's `aria` on objectui's action surfaces, and icon-only renderers take the accessible name from `label`. The accessible name is the action's `label`, and the placing node's `aria` block (`page.components[].aria`, the list view `aria`) names the region.

## What objectui owes, once its spec pin includes `dcd3bcea`

1. **The Studio action editor stops offering an `aria` control.** Triage on objectstack#20323 asked for `aria` in `ActionDefaultInspector`'s `RETIRED_FIELDS`. The objectstack at-tier review (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20398, record `5865383201`) also reads that the served schema's `stripUnauthorableProperties` drops a `{ not: {} }` property structurally. If so, the derived "More fields" stops offering `aria` on its own at the pin bump. Check at the new pin which of the two carries it. Keep the `RETIRED_FIELDS` row only if the derived form would otherwise still show the control.
2. **`packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`** (`:410` at `f8a9d0fb05`) mirrors `aria?: SpecActionInput['aria']`. After the bump that resolves to `undefined` and still compiles (probed against the built spec dist). Remove the dead mirror.

## Not before

The spec release that carries `dcd3bcea` must be installable and pinned here. The criterion is installable, not merged. Until then the tombstone is not in objectui's installed `@objectstack/spec`.

## Dedupe

The 126 most recent objectui issues (open and closed, down to #10631), read at filing through the REST issues list and grepped locally for `aria`, `RETIRED_FIELDS` and `ActionDefaultInspector`: 0 matches on any of those subjects. Control: the same list and grep matches `visibleWhen` titles.

Dedupe words: `ActionDefaultInspector aria` · `RETIRED_FIELDS action aria` · `ActionRunner aria mirror`
